events.factual_description: Village Vanguard presents the John Patitucci Trio featuring Chris Potter and Brian Blade from September 1 through September 6, 2026. The venue identifies Potter on saxophones, Patitucci on bass and Blade on drums. Village Vanguard's current FAQ states that its shows start at 8:00 PM and 10:00 PM, with first-show seating beginning at 7:00 PM and second-show seating at 9:30 PM. The venue's authorized SquadUp artist page independently lists the September 1–6 residency. Edition Records documents the same three musicians as the trio on Patitucci's 2025 album Spirit Fall and notes that the project draws on the New York trio tradition; the album's 'Deluge on Seventh Avenue' was inspired by a memorable earlier week performing at the Vanguard.

en.why_it_matters: This is Patitucci as bandleader rather than famous bassist in somebody else's rhythm section. Potter and Blade are the exact trio on Spirit Fall, a group built around melody, rhythmic elasticity and a bass voice that can lead without crowding the music. The Vanguard matters specifically because the record already carries memory of an earlier week in that room: bringing the working trio back turns the residency into a continuation of the project rather than just another strong New York booking.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is workable during Labor Day week, actively make room for one of the six nights and let the Vanguard anchor the evening. The long run gives enough flexibility to fit the trio around another New York reason without forcing the whole corridor trip onto a single date.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí Patitucci aparece como líder, no como un bajista célebre dentro de la sección rítmica de alguien más. Potter y Blade son el trío exacto de Spirit Fall: un grupo construido alrededor de melodía, elasticidad rítmica y un bajo capaz de conducir sin apretar la música. El Vanguard importa de manera específica porque el disco ya guarda la memoria de una semana anterior en ese cuarto; regresar con el trío de trabajo convierte la residencia en una continuación del proyecto y no simplemente en otra buena contratación neoyorquina.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York resulta viable durante la semana de Labor Day, sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las seis noches y dejaría que el Vanguard ancle la velada. La residencia da suficiente margen para combinar el trío con otra razón para estar en la ciudad sin hacer que todo el viaje por el corredor dependa de una sola fecha.

events.factual_description: Birdland Jazz Club presents Greg Osby's Dancing with Duke — The Music of Duke Ellington from September 1 through September 5, 2026. Birdland describes Osby as leading an all-star band through contemporary interpretations of Ellington and lists Greg Osby on alto saxophone, Eric Harland on drums, Ethan Iverson on piano, JD Allen on tenor saxophone, Lonnie Plaxico on bass and Virginia Macdonald on clarinet. The official event page publishes 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM sets Tuesday through Thursday, then 8:30 PM and 10:30 PM sets Friday and Saturday, with set-specific TicketWeb purchase links. Birdland lists face-value prices of $45.76–$56.06 for the published sets.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is the arrangement problem Osby has set himself: Ellington filtered through an ensemble whose front line is alto saxophone, tenor saxophone and clarinet, with Iverson, Plaxico and Harland underneath. That instrumentation can preserve Ellington's orchestral sense while opening the music to players with very different modern-jazz vocabularies. It is a repertoire project with enough ensemble identity to be more than a tribute set.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play that week, actively make room for one of the ten Birdland sets. Five nights make the project easy to pair with another Manhattan or Brooklyn anchor rather than forcing a trip around one scarce performance.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho está en el problema de arreglo que Osby se plantea: Ellington pasado por un ensamble cuyo frente reúne sax alto, sax tenor y clarinete, con Iverson, Plaxico y Harland sosteniendo la música. Esa instrumentación puede conservar algo del sentido orquestal de Ellington y al mismo tiempo abrir el repertorio a músicos con vocabularios modernos muy distintos. Es un proyecto de repertorio con suficiente identidad de ensamble para ser bastante más que un set de homenaje.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego esa semana, sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los diez sets de Birdland. Cinco noches permiten combinarlo fácilmente con otra ancla en Manhattan o Brooklyn sin construir el viaje alrededor de una sola actuación escasa.
